Camera access is off. You can allow it in the Settings app; the game plays the same without it.
The front camera finds your eyes so the hoop is drawn from your point of view. Frames are analysed on this device and never recorded, stored or sent. Optional: everything plays the same with it off.

Flick the ball up toward the hoop. The speed of your flick sets the power, its direction sets the aim. Three baskets in a row and you're on fire: baskets are worth 3 until you miss. In the last 10 seconds every basket counts double and the hoop starts to move.
On iPhone Duo, stand it half open like a tiny laptop: the hoop rises from the fold. For a duel, open it flat between two players.
